# Intersection superclass forwarding

An owned override forwards its unchanged method-scoped argument to an inherited
superclass declaration with identical ordered interface bounds. The names of the
two lexical formals differ. Source and dependency layouts compile every emitted
Java unit and compare all original identities, access, Code roles, Signature,
Exceptions and parameter metadata. Independently compiled observers exercise
virtual entry, a frozen caller, reflection, method handles, later subclasses,
null and erased invalid inputs, ordered partial effects and exact throwable
identity. In particular, an erased input satisfying only the first bound reaches
the superclass effects before its original second-bound check fails.
